newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction bags big prices for better brew.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction bags big prices for better brew.

text.p: The London Tea Auction saw strong demand and increased prices for better quality teas, the official report said.
Brighter Kenya and Burundi types attracted the most interest with Burundi PF1s commanding up to 171 pence per kg, up by over twenty-five pence since the last sale.
Ceylons sold well and saw substantial gains for better liquoring types, the report said.
Mediums achieved increases of two to three pence per kg.
An offshore offering of 600 packages (34,788 kgs) Zimbabwe tea met with good demand at firm rates.
The next auction is on Monday, February 17. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
